name: spotify
title: Spotify
description: Search, play, queue, like and add to playlists on Spotify from the keyboard, with lyrics that follow the song and a bar item that shows the line playing.
author: pal

settings.label: Client id
settings.description: Your own Spotify app's client id (README: create one at developer.spotify.com with the redirect http://127.0.0.1:27182/callback). No secret is needed: pal signs in with PKCE.

settings.label: Redirect port
settings.description: The port pal listens on for the sign-in redirect; must match the redirect URI registered on the app.

settings.label: Pinned playlists
settings.placeholder: A playlist name, or its spotify:playlist: link
settings.description: Each one is a "Play <name>" row at the root.

now-playing.title: Lyrics
now-playing.description: The track playing with its cover, a ticking progress bar, the state, and lrclib's synced lyrics around the line playing; follows the song while open.

keys.title: Copy the line playing (the track without lyrics)
Search lrclib when it has no lyrics

search.title: Search Spotify
search.description: Tracks, artists, albums, playlists, podcasts and episodes as sections with their cover art.

keys.title: Add to queue (a track); show tracks (a playlist or album)
Add a track to the playlist picked in the bar's field

playlists.title: Playlists
playlists.description: Your playlists and the ones you follow; a drill-in lists the tracks and plays from one.

keys.title: Show tracks (a playlist); add to queue (a track of one)
Like or unlike a track of a listed playlist
Add a listed track to the playlist picked in the bar's field

library.title: Library
library.description: Liked Songs newest first, recently played, and the top tracks and artists of the last weeks, as filters.

keys.title: Liked Songs, Recently played, Top tracks, Top artists
Add to the playlist picked in the bar's field

devices.title: Spotify Devices
devices.description: Every device Spotify is open on: transfer playback to one, and the volume of the active one (up, down, mute, or a level typed in the bar).

keys.title: Play here (a device); volume up, down, mute (the volume rows); on Set volume…, the level typed in the bar's field

queue.title: Queue
queue.description: What plays now and what comes next; skip to a row.

keys.title: Skip to the row (play or pause on the first)
Add to the playlist picked in the bar's field

commands.title: Spotify
commands.description: Play or pause, next, previous, like, lyrics, sign out, and a Play row per pinned playlist, all root results.

keys.title: Open a pinned playlist in Spotify

loaded.description: A track is loaded, playing or paused

playing.title: Spotify
playing.description: The track playing (or the lyric line, with "Lyrics"), hidden while nothing plays; the popover is the lyrics view in a compact layout with the transport keys and the queue's next two, ticking while it is up.

held.title: Paused, kept on the bar (While a track is loaded)

keys.title: Copy the current line (or the track)

rules.description: A loaded track that is paused: off the strip, muted for anyone who keeps it.

settings.label: Lyrics
settings.text: Show the lyric line playing instead of the track name
settings.description: Only when lrclib has synced lyrics for the track; the track name otherwise.

store.tagline: Search, play and queue Spotify from the keyboard
features: Search tracks, artists, albums, playlists and podcasts as you type; `enter` plays, `cmd+enter` queues
Like with `cmd+l`, add to a playlist with `cmd+p`, open in Spotify with `cmd+o`
Your playlists, liked songs, recently played, top tracks, devices and the queue
Synced lyrics around the line playing, with the cover, progress and playback on keys
Play, pause, skip and like from the root, plus a row for each pinned playlist
A bar item with the track or the lyric line playing

screenshots.caption: The lyrics view: the cover, the progress, the line playing bright among the lines around it
Search: tracks, artists, albums, playlists and podcasts as sections
Playlists: yours and the followed ones; cmd+enter lists a playlist's tracks
Library: Liked Songs newest first, the other filters on Tab
The queue: what plays now, what comes next, Enter skips to a row
On the menu bar: the lyric line playing beside the Spotify mark
A track lrclib has no synced lyrics for: the track and the artist in the line's place
A click opens the popover: the cover and the track, the bar ticking, the lyrics around the line playing, the transport keys, and the queue's next two
On sketchybar: the mark in the icon font, the line as the label

actions.title: Play
actions.description: A track, or a playlist, album, artist or show as the context.

actions.title: Show tracks
actions.description: A playlist's or album's tracks as a level; Enter plays from there.

actions.title: Like
actions.description: Adds to or removes from Liked Songs.

actions.title: Add to playlist
actions.description: On any track row: the playlist (yours or a collaborative one) picked in the bar's field; a form with the same select from a hotkey.

actions.title: Search on lrclib
actions.description: When lrclib has no lyrics for the track.

actions.title: Set volume
actions.description: In Devices: the level (0 to 100) typed in the bar, on the active device.

actions.title: Skip to it
actions.description: In the queue: one Next per row ahead.

actions.title: Sign in to Spotify
actions.description: Opens the browser; pal listens on 127.0.0.1 for the redirect.
